plan:
Three sequential structural experiments, each against the preceding accepted state.
1. Packed cached body-motion/contact windows; typed consumer without intermediate motion objects.
2. Separate prefix/suffix trajectory spans through candidate evaluation.
3. Inline native version slots (remove per-version Box allocations).
For each: targeted correctness, freeze sources and binaries, CPU2 paired compile cell61 screen12 / fresh confirm24 only after KEEP; engine guard24 (no REJECT and upper95<+0.5%), compile cell62 guard8 (no REJECT). No rerunning or extending unchanged candidates. A/A12 before first candidate timing. Archive all outcomes, reject inconclusive optimizations. WASM high-water per workload for storage changes. Full structural gates before each adopted commit. Timing and heavy validation never overlap. Source comparison uses clean prior worktree whenever TS changes. A change in internal storage can use same sources with swapped binary. Native physical work, output hashes, scoring arithmetic and early stops must remain exact.

machine.isolation: Sequential timings; no simultaneous builds, tests, parity or profiles. Normal desktop processes remain.

limitations: Paired bootstrap support is not a posterior probability or an anytime-valid stopping rule.
Fixed workload results apply to this machine; unseen songs/hardware are not established.
WASM memory reports high-water linear memory, not live allocations or process RSS.
The existing eval_evidence worker-error test fails because productions/amor_na_praia_46s/audio.mp3 is missing before worker startup.

packed.decision: KEEP: primary compile independently confirmed; engine upper95 +0.429% below +0.5% and no REJECT; larger compile guard passes. Exact structural gates pass apart from documented existing missing-audio test. Compiler WASM high-water is mixed, including a larger-budget increase; no memory-reduction claim.

import subprocess,json,pathlib,sys
root=pathlib.Path('/tmp/engine-dod-20261103')
name,base,candidate,ref=sys.argv[1:]
def run(label,mode,rounds,cells='61',confirm=None,aa=False):
 out=root/f'{name}-{label}'
 args=['taskset','-c','2','npm','run','perf:engine','--',f'--reference={candidate if aa else base}',f'--candidate={candidate}',f'--mode={mode}',f'--cells={cells}',f'--rounds={rounds}','--confirm-rounds=24',f'--out={out}']
 if not aa and ref!='-': args.append(f'--reference-root={ref}')
 if confirm: args += ['--stage=confirm',f'--screen={confirm}/result.json']
 with open(root/f'{name}-{label}.log','w') as log: subprocess.run(args,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 result=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_text()); print(label,json.dumps(result['decision']),flush=True)
 return out,result
if name=='packed':
 _, control=run('aa','compile',12,aa=True)
 assert control['decision']['verdict']=='INCONCLUSIVE', 'A/A unexpectedly directional; investigate before timing candidates'
screen,result=run('screen','compile',12)
if result['decision']['verdict']=='KEEP':
 _,result=run('confirm','compile',24,confirm=screen)
 if result['decision']['verdict']=='KEEP':
  run('engine','engine',24)
  run('large','compile',8,cells='62')
